13: ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
14:     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

16:     # Validate inputs

18:                          ['logp_with_result', 'logp_call_only', 'logp_no_call']):
19:         if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
20:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
21:         if arr.ndim != 2:
22:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
23:         if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
24:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-empty")
25:         if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
26:             raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
27:         if np.any(arr > 0):

29:     # Check shape consistency
30:     shape = logp_with_result.shape
31:     if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
32:         raise ValueError("All matrices must have the same shape")
33:     # Validate tau
34:     if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
35:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
36:     if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):

44:     baseline = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
